newsitem.title: USA: Bando McGlocklin sets meeting on REIT plan.
newsitem.headline: Bando McGlocklin sets meeting on REIT plan.

text.p: Bando McGlocklin Capital Corp said Monday shareholders will be asked at its December 17 annual meeting to approve the company's previously announced plan to reorganize as a real estate investment trust (REIT).

"As we said when our plans were made public, we will continue to specialize primarily in loans to small businesses, and to pay out all of our taxable income in dividends in order to retain our favorable tax status," George Schonath, chairman, said in a statement.
In August, Bando said the conversion to a REIT would free it from unnecessary regulations, but would not change its dividend requirement.
Earlier, Bando reported operating income for the first quarter ended September 30 of $0.27 a share, up from $0.24 a year ago.
